+<project
+   xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"

+   xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0">
+<modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
+<packaging>pom</packaging>
+<groupId>oracle.code</groupId>
+<artifactId>hat-extractions</artifactId>
+<version>1.0</version>
+<parent>
+   <groupId>oracle.code</groupId>
+   <artifactId>hat-root</artifactId>
+   <version>1.0</version>
+</parent>
+<profiles>
+   <profile>
+      <id>cuda</id>
+      <modules>
+         <module>cuda</module>
+      </modules>
+   </profile>
+   <profile>
+      <id>opencl</id>
+      <modules>
+         <module>opencl</module>
+      </modules>
+   </profile>
+   <profile>
+      <id>opengl</id>
+      <modules>
+         <module>opengl</module>
+      </modules>
+   </profile>
+   <profile>
+      <id>linux</id>
+      <activation>
+         <os>
+            <family>unix</family>
+            <name>linux</name>
+         </os>
+      </activation>
+      <properties>
+         <header.path>/usr/include/linux/your_header.h</header.path>
+      </properties>
+   </profile>
+
+   <profile>
+      <id>mac</id>
+      <activation>
+         <os>
+            <family>mac</family>
+         </os>
+      </activation>
+      <properties>
+         <opencl.framework>${mac.app.frameworks.dir}/OpenCL.framework</opencl.framework>
+         <opengl.framework>${mac.app.frameworks.dir}/OpenGL.framework</opengl.framework>
+         <glut.framework>${mac.app.frameworks.dir}/OpenGL.framework</glut.framework>
+         <glut.h>${mac.lib.frameworks.dir}/GLUT.framework/Headers/glut.h</glut.h>
+         <opencl.h>${mac.lib.frameworks.dir}/OpenCL.framework/Headers/opencl.h</opencl.h>
+         <opengl.jextract.cmd>
+            mkdir -p /Users/grfrost/github/babylon-grfrost-fork/hat/extractions/opengl/src;\
+            jextract \
+            -F ${mac.app.frameworks.dir} \
+            --target-package opengl \
+            --output /Users/grfrost/github/babylon-grfrost-fork/hat/extractions/opengl/src  \
+            --library :${opengl.framework}/OpenGL \
+            --library :${glut.framework}/GLUT \
+            --header-class-name opengl_h \
+            ${glut.h}
+         </opengl.jextract.cmd>
+         <opencl.jextract.cmd>
+            mkdir -p /Users/grfrost/github/babylon-grfrost-fork/hat/extractions/opencl/src;\
+            jextract \
+            -F ${mac.app.frameworks.dir} \
+            --target-package opencl \
+            --output /Users/grfrost/github/babylon-grfrost-fork/hat/extractions/opencl/src  \
+            --library :${opengl.framework}/OpenCL \
+            --header-class-name opencl_h \
+            ${opencl.h}
+         </opencl.jextract.cmd>
+      </properties>
+   </profile>
+</profiles>
+
+
+
+<build>
+   <plugins>
+      <plugin>
+         <inherited>false</inherited>
+         <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
+         <artifactId>exec-maven-plugin</artifactId>
+         <version>3.1.0</version>
+         <executions>
+            <execution>
+               <id>loggit</id>
+               <phase>generate-sources</phase>
+               <goals>
+                  <goal>exec</goal>
+               </goals>
+               <configuration>
+                  <executable>echo</executable>
+                  <arguments>
+                     <argument>${opengl.jextract.cmd}</argument>
+                     <argument>${opencl.jextract.cmd}</argument>
+                  </arguments>
+               </configuration>
+            </execution>
+
+            <execution>
+               <id>cmake-B</id>
+               <phase>generate-sources</phase>
+               <goals>
+                  <goal>exec</goal>
+               </goals>
+               <configuration>
+                  <executable>cmake</executable>
+                  <arguments>
+                     <argument>-B</argument>
+                     <argument>cmake-build-debug</argument>
+                  </arguments>
+               </configuration>
+            </execution>
+            <execution>
+               <id>cmake--build</id>
+               <phase>generate-sources</phase>
+               <goals>
+                  <goal>exec</goal>
+               </goals>
+               <configuration>
+                  <executable>cmake</executable>
+                  <arguments>
+                     <argument>--build</argument>
+                     <argument>cmake-build-debug</argument>
+                     <argument>--target</argument>
+                     <argument>extract</argument>
+                  </arguments>
+               </configuration>
+            </execution>
+         </executions>
+      </plugin>
+   </plugins>
+</build>
